# Test corpus

Documents listed in `docs/TESTING.md` section 3 (C-01 to C-30). Every file here is written for Bifolio from scratch. Do not copy test files from other projects.

## Image fixtures (C-16, C-17)

- `images-relative/images.md` references the files in `images-relative/img/` by relative paths, plus references that must be refused or shown as alt text (`../`, absolute, `https:`, `file:`).
- `images-relative/img/rotated-exif.jpg` is stored 48 x 16 with EXIF Orientation 6, so a viewer shows it 16 x 48. Use it to check that bounds read for layout are swapped like the decoded bitmap. `plain.jpg` is 40 x 30 without EXIF.
- `images-oversized.md` embeds its pictures as data URIs (4000 x 300, 300 x 6000, 5000 x 5000 and a 32 x 32 icon) to exercise PAG-07 scaling and push to the next page. The large ones are 1 bit solid PNGs of a few KB at most.
- The binary files and `images-oversized.md` are generated by `testdata/tools/GenerateImages.java` (JDK 11 or newer, standard library only): `java testdata/tools/GenerateImages.java testdata/corpus`. Rerun it after changing the script and commit the result.
